reference_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Stormursa image-to-3D reference for Tetherbound. The supplied image is an identity reference for Staticub, not an edit target. Create ONE isolated full-body adult storm bear, Staticub's optional evolution, as a clean three-quarter game-creature concept render. Preserve Staticub's established warm dark-brown and chestnut layered fur, rounded ears, pale warm muzzle, blue-violet intelligent eyes and restrained blue-violet lightning channels embedded in its fur. Mature the SAME creature into a massive believable quadruped bear with broad muscular shoulders, thick neck, powerful compact legs and broad planted paws. Short bear tail; friendly but formidable face, mouth closed. Natural bear anatomy, four clearly separate legs and paws, clear belly gap and useful articulated joints; no fused limbs, detached fur shells or floating lightning geometry. Refined stylized-realism creature-game appeal, tactile soft fur represented with large clean fur masses and subtle surface texture, no photographic hair strands. Adult proportions and greater shoulder mass than Staticub, target in-engine withers height 4.10m versus source Staticub target 3.25m and trainer 1.80m; the image itself is not a measured scale check. Neutral balanced standing pose, all four feet visible and separable, entire silhouette in frame with generous margin. Plain neutral light-gray background, even studio illumination, subtle grounding only. No copper horns, glass armor, mechanical parts, clothes, red accents, new species traits, electricity cloud, habitat, pedestal, trainer, multiple views, text, logo or watermark. Keep reference suitable for image-to-3D reconstruction.
